method: Searched every stored Chroma chunk of each filing (the full extracted text AskMyDoc can retrieve) for the question's terms and variants, ignoring case and whitespace because extraction glues some words; then read the matching passages to judge whether any states or allows deriving the requested fact. Each case lists the terms searched. Text only present in images was not checked.

cases.question: How many paid Creative Cloud subscribers did Adobe have at FY2022 year end?
cases.closest_material: Mentions Creative Cloud subscribers and subscriptions and ARR definitions; no subscriber count.

cases.question: How many paid Amazon Prime members did Amazon have at the end of FY2017?
cases.closest_material: Describes Amazon Prime membership and how its fees are recognized; no member count.

cases.question: How many flexible packages did Amcor manufacture in FY2023?
cases.closest_material: Flexible packaging segment discussion and percentage volume changes; no package or unit counts.

cases.question: Exactly how many American Express card accounts were closed during FY2022?
cases.closest_material: Cards-in-force totals (e.g. 133.3 million) and attrition as a risk; no count of closed accounts, and cards-in-force changes are net of new cards.

cases.question: How many Cash App users lived in California at FY2020 year end?
cases.closest_material: California appears only for headquarters, auditors and tax credits; Cash App users given only as 36 million+ monthly transacting actives across the US and Europe.

cases.question: How many 737 MAX aircraft did Boeing actually deliver during FY2023?
cases.closest_material: FY2022 filing: only expectations for 2023 (737-7 certification and delivery); actual FY2023 deliveries postdate the filing.

cases.question: How many prescriptions were filled at each individual CVS store in FY2022?
cases.closest_material: Company share of US retail prescriptions (26.8%); no per-store figures.

cases.question: How many boxes of Cheerios did General Mills sell in FY2018?
cases.closest_material: Cheerios appears only in a brand list; no box or unit counts.

cases.question: How many Xbox consoles did Microsoft sell in FY2023?
cases.closest_material: Xbox hardware revenue down 11% on lower volume and price of consoles sold; no unit count.

cases.question: How many individual Gatorade bottles did PepsiCo sell in FY2022?
cases.closest_material: Gatorade volume up mid-single-digit percent; no bottle counts.

cases.question: How many N95 respirator masks did 3M sell in FY2018?
cases.closest_material: N95 never appears; respirator masks appear in asbestos litigation and product lists only.

cases.question: How many MI300 accelerators did AMD ship in FY2022?
cases.closest_material: MI300 never appears; Instinct MI200/MI210 described without shipment counts.

cases.question: How many Call of Duty game copies were sold in FY2019?
cases.closest_material: 'Copies' appears only as master or pirated copies; no Call of Duty unit sales.

cases.question: How many laptop computers did Best Buy sell in Q2 FY2024?
cases.closest_material: Computing and Mobile Phones revenue and comparable-sales percentages; no laptop unit counts.

cases.question: How much electricity did each Entergy nuclear plant generate in actual MWh during FY2010?
cases.closest_material: FY2009 report: planned 2010 generation for the non-utility nuclear fleet as one total (40 TWh) and contract coverage; forecast, not per-plant actuals.

cases.question: How many Band-Aid boxes did Johnson & Johnson sell in FY2022?
cases.closest_material: BAND-AID appears once as a brand; no box or unit counts.

cases.question: What were Pfizer's actual Paxlovid sales in Q2 FY2023?
cases.closest_material: FY2021 filing: forecast of about $22 billion Paxlovid revenue for 2022; nothing about Q2 FY2023 actuals.

cases.question: How many iPhone 14 handsets did Verizon sell in FY2022?
cases.closest_material: 'iPhone' never appears; device sales described only as higher volume and mix.
